posts.text:
More and more studies show that vaccination against various infectious diseases also leads to fewer cardiovascular deaths and lower rates of dementia.

A rational public health system would be getting as many people vaccinated as possible. But. . .
posts.summary: Vaccination reduces cardiovascular deaths and dementia; advocates expanded vaccination programs
